hints.title: Balance Large and Small Values
hints.text: To keep pair sums as balanced as possible, pair the smallest remaining element with the largest remaining element.

hints.title: Sort Array Elements
hints.text: Sort the array in ascending order to easily pair index i with index n - 1 - i.

hints.title: Find Maximum Pair Sum
hints.text: Compute nums[i] + nums[n - 1 - i] for all i < n / 2 and take the maximum.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all possible pair configurations takes double factorial time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting nums allows optimal boundary pairing in O(n log n) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate pairs i with n-1-i on sorted array to minimize max pair sum.
